user.title: Performance Tune
user.description: Fixes for systems with thousands of fast-changing entities. Each fix checks the Home Assistant internals it needs before it is switched on; if an update changed them, it stays off and a repair issue says so. Everything can be changed later in the options.

data.ws_batch: Batch state updates sent to browsers
data.break_cycles: Break the Event–Context cycle of state changes
data.break_cycles_prefixes: For entity ids starting with (one per line)

data_description.ws_batch: Browsers receive changes in one message per interval instead of one message per change. Without it, hundreds of changes per second make the UI lag and disconnect ("Client unable to keep up").
data_description.gc_freeze: Objects that exist after start (states, registries, integrations) are no longer scanned by every full garbage collection.
data_description.break_cycles: Every state change creates a reference cycle that only the full (blocking) garbage collection frees. It is used by the live logbook for "triggered by"; sensors with a unit of measurement have no logbook entries.
data_description.patch_paho: paho-mqtt creates a self-referencing closure for every incoming message. The replacement is checked to give identical results before it is switched on.
